channel.title: Awesome livros de IA
channel.description: Books on artificial intelligence in Portuguese: from first use to the profession, from builders to the debate.

item.title: IA no dia a dia (vol. 1)
item.description: What everyone needs to know about artificial intelligence to work.

item.title: IA por dentro (vol. 2)
item.description: How the machines that talk to us work.

item.title: IA no escritório (vol. 3)
item.description: For secretaries, assistants and administrative aides.

item.title: IA no primeiro trabalho (vol. 4)
item.description: From job offer to first payslip, for those just starting out.

item.title: IA no pequeno negócio (vol. 5)
item.description: From WhatsApp to the cash register, for the MEI and small business owners.

item.title: IA no atendimento e nas vendas (vol. 6)
item.description: For salespeople, cashiers, receptionists and telemarketing operators.

item.title: IA na sala de aula (vol. 7)
item.description: For teachers: lesson plans, grading, adapted activities and reports without exposing the student.

item.title: IA na contabilidade (vol. 8)
item.description: For accountants, technicians and assistants: from bank statements to DCTFWeb, without exposing the client.

item.title: IA na advocacia (vol. 9)
item.description: For lawyers: petitions, case law and deadlines, without fake rulings or exposing the client.

item.title: Construir com IA (vol. 10)
item.description: From prototype to live system: login, data and billing for people who build without knowing how to code.

item.title: Feito para agentes (vol. 11)
item.description: How to make your customer's AI agent use your product: MCP server, llms.txt and authorization.

item.title: A empresa de uma pessoa (vol. 12)
item.description: One Person Business: how to set up and run a whole business with AI agents.

item.title: Do primeiro visitante ao cliente (vol. 13)
item.description: How to set up, with AI agents, your storefront, lead generation and customer relationships.

item.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (vol. 14)
item.description: How to become the engineer who takes AI from pilot to production.

item.title: Cointeligência
item.description: Ethan Mollick, professor at Wharton, on living and working with AI as a colleague. Intrínseca.

item.title: Nexus
item.description: Yuval Noah Harari tells the story of information networks, from the Stone Age to AI. Companhia das Letras.

item.title: A próxima onda
item.description: Mustafa Suleyman and Michael Bhaskar on AI, power and the biggest dilemma of the century. Record.

item.title: Superinteligência
item.description: Nick Bostrom on the paths, dangers and strategies facing an AI more capable than we are. DarkSide.

item.title: Vida 3.0
item.description: Max Tegmark on human beings in the age of artificial intelligence. Benvirá.

item.title: Awesome IA no trabalho
item.description: Assistants, privacy and official sources, with a list per profession.
